term_guard_basis: SHA256 of structured category/configuration count/engine-party, selected public plan names/meal/cancellation strings and observation fee/deposit basis in that order; a maintained term change requires explicit requalification, not automatic reuse of derived age/fee/cancellation wording.

comparison.basis: Same named room, count-only search, dates, public plan, displayed tax-and-destination-fee stay totals and published cancellation terms. Compare total cents before deriving nightly equivalent, not rounded nightly values.

task.family_decision: Does the dated breakfast upgrade cover this whole family and what does it add to the flexible room plan?
task.hypothesis: Published rates and long fee notes already expose incremental cost and full-family meal coverage
task.result: Rejected in page-only task: parents must subtract totals and join meal age limits. Implement direct source-derived increment and included-versus-uncovered child comparison; do not infer a value winner.
task.confidence: High maintained amount/age/date/plan parity and arithmetic; unknown current rates, exact age acceptance, meal prices/service, bedding, users and SEO
task.falsification_trigger: Source/price/meal/cancellation change, record join or visible task failure; original price review October15
task.next_gate: Focused/full/responsive/filter/download QA, different read-only PASS and exact production-verified release

limitations: Requested ages are task context, not entered or provider-confirmed ages in the original counts-only search
Displayed tax and destination fee included once, not complete all-fee or fifth-bed budget
Children8/12 breakfast cost unknown; no all-family free meal or cheaper/value claim
Stay premium is not an amount per breakfast/person, no assumed number of breakfasts or meal consumption
No food credits subtracted, cancellation/card hold not another fee, nonrefundable plan is not the comparison baseline
October9 assessment does not renew October1 source/price or October15 review clock; no provider replay
public_change: Existing approved Boston URL only; no new URL or original CSV/data change
